result.instructions: Tools for Rental Software, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our rental items are free on Saturday 7/25/2026?"; "What are our most rented items over the last 90 days?"; "Show me the open leads for this month and their totals.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Rental Software data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rentalsoftware_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rentalsoftware_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rentalsoftware_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. rentalsoftware_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rentalsoftware_list_rentals
tools.title: List rental items
tools.description: List the active rental items in the inventory, optionally one category. Returns short records; set include_details for full records. Uses GET /rentals.

category_id.description: Only items in this category (from rentalsoftware_list_categories).

changes_since.description: Only items created or changed since this time.

offset.description: Record number to start at. The first record is 0.

tools.name: rentalsoftware_get_rental
tools.title: Get rental item
tools.description: Read one rental item with its options, category, images and optionally its hourly prices. Uses GET /rentals/{id}.

include_prices.description: true adds the price details by hour (slower).

tools.name: rentalsoftware_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List the inventory categories with their IDs and names. Uses GET /categories_list.

offset.description: Record number to start at. The first record is 0.

location_id.description: Multi-location accounts only: categories of that location.

tools.name: rentalsoftware_list_popular_items
tools.title: List popular items
tools.description: List the most rented items, most rented first, over the last N days (times rented on completed events). Uses GET /popular_items.

last_x_days.description: How many days to look back (default 30).

include_accessories.description: true also counts options and accessories.

offset.description: Record number to start at. The first record is 0.

tools.name: rentalsoftware_availability_on_day
tools.title: Availability on a day
tools.description: Show how many of each item are rented and available on one day (midnight to midnight, account time zone). Uses GET /availability_list. An empty day returns one entry named 'No items to display'.

date.description: Date as MM/DD/YYYY. The account's date setting decides the order: if the account uses DD/MM/YYYY, send the date in that order.

tools.name: rentalsoftware_check_availability_and_price
tools.title: Check availability and price
tools.description: Check whether items are free for a start and end time and get the price. Read-only: it changes nothing. Uses POST /availability_pricing with a JSON body.

start.description: Start time as a Unix timestamp (seconds or milliseconds).

end.description: End time as a Unix timestamp. Must be after start.

rental_id.description: Rental item ID as an integer (from rentalsoftware_list_rentals).

accessories.description: Options or accessories to include with this item.

rental_id.description: Rental item ID as an integer (from rentalsoftware_list_rentals).

location_id.description: Inventory location ID (default: the key's first location).

speedy.description: true runs the faster, lighter check for browsing many dates.

tools.name: rentalsoftware_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers. Returns short records; set include_details for full records. Uses GET /customers.

offset.description: Record number to start at. The first record is 0.

tools.name: rentalsoftware_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Read one customer: contact, address, tags and custom fields. Uses GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: rentalsoftware_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List or search leads (quotes, bookings). Use a saved filter name, or the search fields, not both. An unknown filter name returns leads with no filter applied. Uses GET /leads.

filter.description: Name or numeric ID of a saved lead filter.

keyword.description: Search event name, organization, venue, city, zip, lead ID, customer name, email or phone.

modified_date.description: Leads modified in a range, for example past_days_1 or 7/1/2026 - 7/31/2026.

create_date.description: Leads created in a range, for example past_days_7.

event_date.description: Leads with an event in a range, for example future_days_30.

event_starts_in_range.description: true counts only events that start inside event_date.

offset.description: Record number to start at. The first record is 0.

tools.name: rentalsoftware_get_lead
tools.title: Get lead
tools.description: Read one lead: its rentals and prices, status, customer and totals. Set include_details for worker shifts and attachments. Uses GET /leads/{id}.

tools.name: rentalsoftware_list_setup_list
tools.title: List setup list
tools.description: Read one of the account's setup lists: lead statuses, surfaces, delivery methods, customer types, payment types or referral sources. Uses GET /{list}_list.

offset.description: Record number to start at. The first record is 0.

tools.name: rentalsoftware_get_stats
tools.title: Get dashboard statistics
tools.description: Read the dashboard statistics for a time window (default: the last 30 days). Needs the Dashboard Stats permission. Uses GET /stats.

start.description: Window start as a Unix timestamp (default 30 days ago).

end.description: Window end as a Unix timestamp (default now). Must be after start.

tools.name: rentalsoftware_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: Create a customer record. Returns the new record ID in recordid. Uses POST /customers.

name.description: Full name in one field; the vendor splits it into first and last name.

cellphone.description: Mobile phone. The vendor formats numbers when it can.

customer_type.description: Must match a customer type set up in the account.

tags.description: Tags to attach to the customer.

location_id.description: Multi-location accounts only: the location to create the customer under.

tools.name: rentalsoftware_update_customer
tools.title: Update customer
tools.description: Update fields on one customer. Fields you do not send stay the same; an empty value is ignored, so a field cannot be blanked. Uses POST /customers/{id}.

name.description: Full name in one field; the vendor splits it into first and last name.

cellphone.description: Mobile phone. The vendor formats numbers when it can.

customer_type.description: Must match a customer type set up in the account.

tags.description: Tags to attach to the customer.

replace_tags.description: true replaces the saved tags with `tags` instead of adding to them.

tools.name: rentalsoftware_create_lead
tools.title: Create lead
tools.description: Create a lead (a quote or booking) for an event. Pass an existing customer_id, or customer fields to match or create one. event_zip is required. Uses POST /leads.

customer_id.description: Existing customer ID. Without it, the customer fields below match or create one.

customer_name.description: Customer full name (used when no customer_id).

event_start.description: Event start as a Unix timestamp in seconds (default: now).

event_end.description: Event end as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Use this or event_duration_hours.

status.description: Lead status name, as set up in the account (for example Hold).

tools.name: rentalsoftware_update_lead
tools.title: Update lead
tools.description: Update fields on one lead. Fields you do not send stay the same. Availability is checked again when dates change. Uses POST /leads/{id}.

tools.name: rentalsoftware_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: Create a task linked to a customer, lead or organization, with an optional reminder. Needs the Sales CRM add-on. Uses POST /tasks.

linked_name.description: Name of the customer, lead or organization the task is linked to.

linked_id.description: ID of that customer, lead or organization.

assigned_worker_id.description: Worker the task is assigned to.

remind_date.description: Date as MM/DD/YYYY. The account's date setting decides the order: if the account uses DD/MM/YYYY, send the date in that order.

tools.name: rentalsoftware_add_journal_entry
tools.title: Add journal entry
tools.description: Add a journal (CRM log) entry to a lead or a customer. Give lead_id or customer_id. Needs the Sales CRM add-on. Uses POST /journals.

lead_id.description: Lead to link the entry to (or use customer_id).

customer_id.description: Customer to link the entry to (or use lead_id).

this_lead_only.description: With lead_id: true keeps the entry on that lead only, not all the customer's leads.

assigned_worker_id.description: Worker the entry is assigned to.

prompts.name: find_the_most_rented_items

prompts.description: Add a journal entry to a lead or a customer. Create a task linked to a customer, lead or organization, with an optional reminder.

prompts.name: read_dashboard_statistics_for_a_period
prompts.title: Read dashboard statistics for a period
prompts.description: Read the dashboard statistics for a time window, such as the last 30 days.
